Does a Sauna Help You Lose Weight?

A sauna session makes you lighter, but almost all of that is water lost as sweat, and it comes back when you drink. In a study of 674 students, a 20-minute dry sauna session took off about 0.8 lb for women and 1.1 lb for men on average. No good study shows a sauna causes meaningful fat loss on its own.
